summary: The change forwards temperature/top_p when DeepSeek thinking is disabled and reports ignored-field warnings when it is active.

evidence: src/deepseek/chat-projection.ts:709-720 forwards temperature and top_p for disabled thinking, preserving values such as temperature 0, and records warnings otherwise.
src/deepseek/handlers.ts:655-721 propagates those warnings onto dispatch failures, streaming responses, and buffered responses.
tests/deepseek-sampling-controls.test.ts:6-28 covers reasoning.effort none with temperature 0/top_p and verifies active-mode warnings.
